about: Curated browse pages. A template joins a collection when one of its tags matches a collection tag (whole tag, or a whole word inside a tag), or its kind or source matches. Pages with fewer than 5 templates are not built.

collections.title: Cat memes
collections.intro: Meme templates starring cats: yelling, staring, crying, typing and judging.

collections.title: Dog memes
collections.intro: Meme templates with dogs, from Doge and Cheems to the dog in the burning room.

collections.title: Animal memes
collections.intro: Meme templates with animals other than cats and dogs: monkeys, birds, bears, seals and more.

collections.title: SpongeBob memes
collections.intro: Every SpongeBob SquarePants template in the catalog, from Mocking SpongeBob to Squidward's window.

collections.title: Reaction faces
collections.intro: Faces and moments people paste in as a reply: shock, disgust, smugness, confusion, awkward silence.

collections.title: Choice and decision memes

collections.title: Comparison memes
collections.intro: Templates that set two or more things against each other: strong versus weak, then versus now, expectation versus reality.

collections.title: Work and office memes
collections.intro: Templates about bosses, meetings, coworkers and the job.

collections.title: School memes
